children: Mosaic's executive vice president of operations, Karen Swager, is retiring after more than three decades with the potash and phosphate fertilizer producer.
Mosaic on Wednesday said Walt Precourt, currently senior vice president and chief administrative officer, will succeed Swager as executive vice president of operations on Dec. 1.
Swager, who has been in her current post since November 2023, will serve as a senior adviser until her retirement in the second quarter of 2027, the Tampa, Fla., company said.
Precourt joined Mosaic in 2009 and has been a member of the company's executive leadership team since 2014.
